description: AUTHORITATIVE for US Census geography records: query any TIGERweb layer with an ArcGIS WHERE clause and get the matching geographies with their GEOID, name, FIPS components, land/water area and interior point. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for questions like "every census tract in Cook County", "all ZCTAs in Rhode Island", or "the GEOID of this school district". Get layer_id from tigerweb_list_layers.

out_fields.description: Comma-separated field names, or "*" for all (default "*")

return_geometry.description: Include boundary geometry. Default false — polygons are very large.

where.description: ArcGIS WHERE clause, default "1=1". FIPS fields are STRINGS: STATE='11', COUNTY='031'. Supports AND/OR/LIKE.

name: tigerweb_query
title: Tigerweb Query
